kpis.name: Real Interest Rate (Saver's Yield)
kpis.subtitle: G-Sec 10Y yield minus inflation: if positive, savers beat the price rise; if negative, savings quietly lose value.
kpis.source: RBI DBIE 10Y G-Sec Yield — DEMO SNAPSHOT − World Bank CPI

kpis.name: Real Inflation Rate (Headline)
kpis.subtitle: The official Consumer Price Index growth — the number people usually mean by 'it is getting more expensive.'

kpis.name: Regional Inflation Spread
kpis.subtitle: The gap the national average hides — e.g. Rajasthan shows much bigger spikes than the headline number.
kpis.source: State CPIs (MoSPI) − National CPI — DEMO SNAPSHOT

kpis.name: Digital Consumption Velocity (UPI Ticket)
kpis.subtitle: Average value per UPI transaction, tracked alongside GST collections growth — value moving faster than volume means faster digital money flow.

kpis.name: Import Cover Ratio
kpis.subtitle: Forex reserves as a multiple of one month's imports — if it falls, India can import less month to month.
kpis.source: RBI DBIE Forex Reserves — DEMO SNAPSHOT

kpis.name: Reserve Adequacy Ratio
kpis.subtitle: FX reserves as a share of short-term debt — above 1.0 means the reserve pile covers the near-term debt bill.
kpis.source: RBI DBIE Forex Reserves — DEMO SNAPSHOT

kpis.name: Debt Service Burden
kpis.subtitle: Interest paid on public debt as a share of revenue — when it rises, tax money that could fund health or schools instead pays interest.
kpis.source: RBI DBIE debt-service composition — DEMO SNAPSHOT

kpis.name: GDP per Capita (Nominal)
kpis.subtitle: Average economic output per person — the usual headline number global rankings use.

kpis.name: PPP Gap (Nominal − PPP)
kpis.subtitle: The difference between nominal and purchasing-power-parity GDP per capita — the gap that explains why the same salary buys a different life in Jaipur vs Delhi.

kpis.name: PPP Conversion Multiple
kpis.subtitle: How many times bigger the PPP-adjusted GDP per capita is versus the nominal one — a quick picture of how prices change a salary.

kpis.name: GDP Growth (Annual %)
kpis.subtitle: How fast the economy is growing, year over year.

kpis.name: Index of Industrial Production Growth
kpis.subtitle: How fast factories, mines and utilities are actually growing — a real-time check of business activity.

kpis.name: Power Demand Growth
kpis.subtitle: Growth in electricity use — a rough check of whether industry is turning on the lights or the meters are moving fast.

global_resilience.note: Ranked against India on real GDP growth where World Bank data is available. Current account and FDI columns fill in where data exists.
